# Política de calidad
APCERAM CERAMICAS TECNICAS, S.L. (APCERAM) is a company created in 1996 with the purpose of producing and developing technical ceramic components for any industrial application.   
  
The activity that APCERAM considers to comply with the quality required by the International Standard ISO 9001:2015 is:  
  
Custom manufacturing of technical ceramics parts.  
  
The Policy statement includes as guidelines:  
  
1. Commitment to meet the requirements of our clients and legal and regulatory requirements.  
2. Having equipment and manufacturing processes that allow us to process and manufacture a wide variety of pieces in different ceramic materials with the highest standards of quality and precision.  
3. Use high-quality materials.  
4. Offer our customers technical advice on both materials and products.  
5. Ensure that working conditions are optimal by evaluating the risks that may occur in the processes, eliminating them as much as possible and reducing those evaluated.  
6. Commitment to continuous improvement of the management system implemented in the company.  
7. Promote and achieve a motivating environment for all members of the company.  
  
The Management makes this policy accessible and makes it available to its customers, all its employees, suppliers and other interested parties.  
  
The Policy is kept up to date through periodic reviews, coinciding with system reviews by management, in order to take into account changes in environmental conditions and the information received. In this sense, the management provides and will provide all the necessary human, technical and economic means to achieve the objectives and goals that are established on a scheduled and periodic basis.

# Wire Industry
In the wire industry, there are miles of wire drawn, and redirected and treated and wound daily, which require pulleys, rollers and guides with which to perform such work.  
  
Ceramic materials are suitable for the manufacture of these elements due to their high wear resistance. The use of ceramic components has proven effective in these applications and their use is widespread in the industry.  
  
In addition the use of materials with small particle size allows exceptional surface finishes on parts, allowing the high quality wire to be produces for much longer time, thus preventing the production of lower quality items.  
  
For the manufacture of these components Apceram normally uses MgPSZ and YPSZ zirconias, and silicon carbide.

# High temperature
Another principal characteristic of engineering ceramics is their ability to withstand high temperatures.  
  
Normally the parameters to be considered for these applications include use temperature, the thermal shock the piece must withstand, hot-cold number of cycles to bear, the atmosphere in which the ceramic component will work at, the mechanical force exerted.  
  
For these applications Apceram manufactures parts in silicon carbide and 96-98 and 99% alumina.

# Silicon carbide
Silicon carbide is one of the hardest materials known to man, and this makes it a suitable material for wear resistant applications.  
  
It has a very low coefficient of thermal expansion and a high thermal conductivity, it is also capable of supporting loads up to 1700 º C. These properties make it an excellent refractory at high temperatures.  
  
Other features of silicon carbide are its low density, high stability against chemical attack and the possibility for high quality surface finishes.  
  
Apceram manufactures sintered alpha silicon carbide for various applications.

# High performance ceramics
Although the term "ceramic" is normally associated with materials that are considered fragile, this is no longer the case. Technical ceramics have advanced over the past few decades and today are present in all fields of science and technology.  
  
The remarkable features of engineering ceramics are:  
  
**- High hardness.  
- High resistance to chemical attack.  
- Resistance to high and low temperatures.  
- Good electrical insulation.  
- Low density.**  
  
This combination of material properties allow technical ceramics to replace other commonly used materials such metals or plastics.

# Welding
In the spot welding process, the centering elements of both nuts and bolts and the positioning of parts need to withstand high temperatures, prevent adhesion of welding projections and be electrically isolated.  
  
Ceramic materials offer all these properties without the need for treatment or insulation outside the centering pin. YPSZ zirconia is particularly suitable due to its high bending strength, chemical stability and good surface finish.  
  
In welding sheet metal, such as large pieces of boiler and shipbuilding, ceramic backings allow excellent welding finish without any further trimming.  
  
Apceram can produce ceramic backings normally using 92% alumina.
